content: {"like": ["Values high production quality and faithful releases (e.g., full‑frame Blu‑ray, superb sound).", "Enjoys well‑executed genre films, especially dark, creepy, or heavy‑metal horror.", "Appreciates strong performances and high ratings in specific titles (e.g., Wolf, Frank meets Wolf).", "Prefers films that deliver satisfying narrative arcs and avoid anticlimactic endings.", "Shows enthusiasm for niche or cult classics, especially those that stand out in their category."], "dislike": ["Criticizes weak plot continuity, filler content, and anticlimactic reveals.", "Dislikes low‑quality releases (cropped DVDs, poor mastering, visual artifacts).", "Shows strong aversion to poorly executed or “worst” movies and negative fan culture.", "Rejects titles that don’t meet genre expectations (e.g., Wolf of London, She Wolf).", "Values narrative depth and is disappointed by unsatisfying character arcs or abrupt resolutions."]}
